rootCause: Relocating every module build directory invalidates the canonical artifact catalog and runtime launchers, which deliberately consume conventional ownerPath/build outputs. The private repository-root build/cache/crash isolation requirement does not authorize silently breaking those consumers.
repair: Retain conventional module build ownership while isolating repository-root and project-cache/JVM failure state; remove module outputs through an exact post-validation garbage cleanup rather than changing 80+ artifact/runtime contracts.
